text: Webhooks can include a custom Authorization header (e.g. Bearer token) for authentication
quote: You can now set an Authorization header on webhooks. Pass the full value, scheme included, like Bearer <token>.

text: Postgres instance, storage, and PgBouncer metrics have dedicated, shareable graph pages
quote: Postgres instance, storage, and PgBouncer graphs now live on their own tabs with shareable URLs.

text: Org admins can enable and manage SSO directly from the CLI
quote: Organization administrators can now enable and manage SSO from the CLI with pscale org sso.

text: Webhook events fire on backup success or failure so you're notified automatically
quote: We've added backup.succeeded and backup.failed webhook events. You'll get notified when a backup finishes, whether it worked or not.

text: Postgres branches can be created restored to a specific point-in-time timestamp
quote: You can now create a PostgreSQL branch restored to a point-in-time timestamp with --restore-point.

text: CLI can list switchovers for a branch and show a specific switchover by ID
quote: After starting a switchover, you can now list switchovers for a branch and show one by ID.

text: CLI can show a single service token by its ID
quote: You can now show a single service token by ID.

text: CLI can list available regions for a database and its configured Vitess read-only regions
quote: You can now list the regions available to a database, and list configured Vitess read-only regions for the database's default branch.

text: Database schemas can be branched the same way code is branched
quote: PlanetScale allows you to branch database schemas the same way you branch your code.

text: Postgres branches are isolated deployments for development, testing, and restoring from backups
quote: Branches on PlanetScale Postgres are isolated database deployments that provide you with separate environments for development and testing, as well as restoring from backups.

text: Branching plus deploy requests lets you ship schema changes to production with zero downtime
quote: Database branching, coupled with deploy requests, allows you to deploy non-blocking schema changes to your production database with zero downtime.

text: Backups can be created, scheduled, and restored for production and development branches
quote: PlanetScale provides the ability to create, schedule, and restore backups for production and development database branches.

text: An in-dashboard import tool migrates an existing internet-accessible MySQL/MariaDB database with no downtime
quote: PlanetScale provides an import tool in the dashboard that allows you to painlessly import an existing internet-accessible MySQL or MariaDB database with **no downtime**.

text: Appending |replica to a username routes connections to a read replica branch
quote: Append `|replica` to the end of your username for the branch you want to target

text: Large monolithic databases can be sharded and spread across multiple servers
quote: PlanetScale allows you to break up a large monolithic database and spread the data out across multiple servers.

text: Metal offering provides high-IOPS NVMe SSD performance for demanding workloads
quote: Metal is an excellent choice for high-IOPS and other performance-critical workloads. With Metal, your database now has the ability to use modern NVMe SSD technology to its full potential.

text: pscale sql lets agents and scripts run SQL non-interactively
quote: Run non-interactive SQL for agents and scripts (`pscale sql`)

text: Server-side analysis surfaces aggregated query stats, failing query patterns, resource anomalies, and schema recommendations from production traffic
quote: Surface PlanetScale's server-side analysis of a database: aggregated query statistics, failing query patterns, resource anomalies, and schema recommendations, all computed from production traffic.

text: MCP-compatible tools like Claude, Cursor, and Notion can connect to PlanetScale databases and Insights
quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Notion, and other MCP-compatible tools to your PlanetScale databases and Insights

text: An agent can autonomously identify high-impact performance issues, edit code, and open a pull request
quote: an agent identifies the highest-impact performance issues, finds the relevant code, makes improvements, and opens a pull request

text: Read replicas reduce load on the primary database by serving reads
quote: They provide a way to reduce load on your primary instance by allowing you to read from a replica.

text: Metal delivers reduced latency, consistent IO, and unlimited IOPS
quote: This translates to significant latency reduction, more consistent IO performance, and unlimited I/O Operations Per Second (IOPS).

text: CLI can open a secure interactive MySQL or PostgreSQL shell
quote: Open a secure MySQL or PostgreSQL shell instance

text: Dashboard shows current and historical usage per database
quote: View your current and previous usage per database

text: Top queries can be listed ranked by a chosen performance metric
quote: List top queries ranked by a performance metric

text: Agents can run on a recurring schedule to review Insights/Schema Recommendations and open performance-improvement PRs
quote: Agents can review production Insights data and Schema Recommendations, then open pull requests with performance improvements — on a recurring schedule.

text: Development branches can be created and used before shipping schema changes to production
quote: You can then create development branches that you can use for development before shipping schema changes to production.

text: Manual backups can be created in addition to the automatic daily default backups
quote: In addition to the daily default backups that PlanetScale schedules for your database branches, you can create additional manual backups.
